Why it matters: Subscription expires with no debit ever attempted. 100% correlation across all 27 expired trials and all 5 expired payers.
Done when: No live subscription has a null next-payment date with an active mandate

Task: Rescue the 14 already-detached subscriptions
Why it matters: 9 live subs (~Rs 15919/mo at risk) + 5 of 25 current trials will never be charged. These die whether or not A1 ships.

Task: Close RECURRING_TOKEN_NOT_CONFIRMED
Why it matters: 30% of first-charge failures. All 14 rows UPI; all had Rs 10 captured 5-6 days earlier. Notion says activation gate shipped but data shows it firing on 21 Jul - verify.

Task: Suppress dunning on paused mandates
Why it matters: Paused mandates are alive. Sending 're-authorize' to someone who deliberately paused is the worst message in the system.
Done when: Paused state branches before any dunning fires

Task: Fix retry promise in live transactional copy
Why it matters: Copy says 'we'll retry automatically' and cites '2 retries over 48h'. That flow does not exist.

Task: Confirm whether WCS automatic retry is enabled at all
Why it matters: WCS ships retry OFF by default. Zero retries across 47 failures is what a disabled system looks like. May be a setting not a build.

Task: Confirm PDN-on-retry mechanics with Razorpay
Why it matters: Every UPI debit needs a pre-debit notification 24h ahead. Determines whether Razorpay auto-fires it or we trigger it. Sets minimum retry interval.

Task: Implement retry eligibility by failure code
Why it matters: 30% of failures are dead mandates. Retrying them is pure noise and generates cancel prompts. Insufficient balance = retry; token-not-confirmed / cancelled / expired = never.
Done when: Eligibility rules live and unit tested

Task: Implement schedule with hard cap and grace stop
Why it matters: Attempt 1 day 7; +3d; +7d; next salary window (1st-3rd). Stop at 4 attempts or 15-day grace deadline. Indian salary credits cluster month-end - timing to it beats a fixed 48h cadence.

Task: Add attempt-level logging
Why it matters: 111 of 113 billing cycles have exactly one attempt recorded. Log attempt no. / timestamp / PDN sent at / failure code / outcome. Without it the schedule cannot be tuned.

Task: Implement stop conditions
Why it matters: Paid / mandate dead / grace expired / max attempts reached.
Done when: All four conditions halt the loop

Task: Wire the token.cancelled webhook
Why it matters: Revocations surface via polling today. In 0 of 91 cases did we record the revocation before the next charge already failed. The entire winback window is thrown away.
Done when: Revocation recorded same-day before any charge attempt

Task: Handle paused as a first-class state
Why it matters: Branch on pause_initiated_by. Self-pause suppresses dunning and schedules a resume-date nudge. Paused mandates outnumber cancellations.
Done when: Pause state handled end to end

Task: Read all three note sources in any churn query
Why it matters: 93 'customer cancelled' notes sit on parent orders and 17 on renewal orders with no counterpart on the subscription record. Reading subscription notes alone misses 110 cancellations.
Done when: Query reads subscription + parent order + renewal order notes

Task: Pull distinct subscription count behind the 263 paused notes
Why it matters: 263 is note occurrences from a repeating poll not 263 people. Sizes the best list in the system.

Task: Split all four lists by trial vs payer
Why it matters: Value per head differs enormously and decides effort allocation.

Why it matters: Cancel-vs-PDN timing is the most diagnostic test available. If not logged start logging today.

Task: Get Razorpay token state history with timestamps
Why it matters: Current-state-only data answers no timing question.

Why it matters: Determines who can self-serve future pulls.
